 15 photos as thousands of Black Cats fans take over Poznan before Europa League game against Lech Poznan 
 Go to the comments section Add to your bookmarks Share this article According to Sunderland Echo, thousands of Sunderland supporters have descended on Poznan ahead of tonight’s third Europa League match against Lech Poznan. In keeping with their familiar chant, it has been another Sunderland takeover in Poland.
 The red and white army moved on to the city after last week’s 1-2 victory over Torreense in Portugal. Large numbers gathered last night as the build-up continued.
 OneFootball Videos
 Supporters assembled in the Old Market Square, flags on show, sampling Polish beers and backing Sunderland AFC ahead of the game.
 Fans have shared photographs from their time in Poland, capturing the colour and camaraderie of the travelling support.
 Here are 15 images of Black Cats fans in Poznan ahead of tonight’s game.
 Source: Sunderland Echo
